decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed erection of a side and rear roof extension to this house  because of its position, design and appearance would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 23 Thornbury Avenue and is complimentary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties and will preserve the character of the Spring Grove Conservation Area.  The development is in accordance with the adopted UDP policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development),  ENVB 2.2(Conservation Areas), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003, and is compliant  with Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the roof extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the roof extension is used.
Condition : 5 - The roof extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 23 Thornbury Avenue.
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the west elevation shall be obscure glazed  and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a side and rear roof extension to existing house.
